U.note: Cheerful scene and helmet, but the bulky body sits awkwardly on the frame and the wing floats like a flat slab.

V.note: Polished cargo-bike scene with detailed chain, crate and fish, though the cargo bike is an embellishment and the pelican's long thin neck is a bit odd.

W.note: Clear pelican with big pouch on a proper bike, pedalling legs reach the pedals and controls work.

X.note: Most convincing pelican with an expressive pouch, seated on a detailed bike with chain and gears and a well-drawn scene.

Y.note: Pelican reads well but the legs look stiff and straight and the wheels are bare, and the pelican sits oddly high.

Z.note: Clean, simple pelican and bike with working pause and speed, but the pelican floats a bit above the bike and the wheels are small.
